description: This file defines a grain class for Orleans, specifically a consumer that handles streaming batch data, reports consumption statistics, and distinguishes between batching and non-batching streams.

classes.name: BatchingStreamBatchingTestConsumerGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain that consumes stream data, tracking batch consumption and handling subscriptions.

methods.name: GetConsumptionReport
methods.description: Returns the current report of consumed items and batching metrics.

methods.name: OnSubscribed
methods.description: Handles subscription setup, resumes stream handling based on namespace.

methods.name: OnNextBatch
methods.description: Processes a batch of streamed items, updating consumption metrics.

methods.name: OnNext
methods.description: Processes individual stream items when not batching.
